correctness.rationale: Subtract hub value after replacing f by |f|; with D=m+q,t=1/(1+q),x_i=f(leaf_i)-f(hub), A=sum x_i/D, the hub maximal deviation is max(0,A), leaf is max(x_i,t*x_i,A). If A>=0 output variation=sum_i (x_i-A)_+ <= (1-1/D)sum|x_i|. If A<0, positive deviations sum P and negative output deviations are min(t v_i,(N-P)/D); if P>0 there are at most m-1 negative leaves and variation <=(1-1/D)(P+N), while P=0 gives <=tN. Indicator witnesses attain two branches. Branch monotonicity gives unique crossing q. Independently enumerated deviations [-2,2]^m for m=3,4,5 and q=1/4,1,3 with exact fractions; all maxima equal claimed C, including q=1 earlier counting case. Exhaustion is of test grids only, not of arbitrary functions.
